what_it_counts: Swaps settled through NEAR Intents on every route, public and confidential, as NEAR reports them on revenue.near.org. This is fct_intents_daily.volume_usd, not DefiLlama's listing of NEAR Intents (dexs/near-intents, id 6225), whose scope changed during 2026
Swaps through THORChain's own pools, from its Midgard index, in RUNE at the day's RUNE price. Every swap settles on THORChain between native assets of different chains
why_compare: Swaps native assets across chains from its own pools; the oldest service of this kind

what_it_counts: Swaps executed on the Chainflip protocol, whose own chain settles swaps between native assets of different chains
why_compare: Swaps native assets across chains from its own pools

what_it_counts: Tokens sent from a chain through successful Relay cross-chain requests, each counted once on the chain it leaves. Same-chain swaps are left out; a request that delivers the same token on another chain counts
why_compare: Fills cross-chain requests from a solver's own funds on the destination chain

what_it_counts: Deposits into Across's SpokePool on each chain, which relayers fill on the destination chain, each counted once on the chain it leaves. Expired and refunded deposits are left out; a deposit that delivers the same token on another chain counts
why_compare: Fills cross-chain orders from relayers' own funds on the destination chain

what_it_counts: Tokens sent from a chain through Mayan cross-chain swaps, each counted once on the chain it leaves and priced from the source token. Same-chain swaps and refunded orders are left out
why_compare: Fills cross-chain swaps through an auction among solvers

what_it_counts: Tokens committed to deBridge DLN orders created on each chain, which takers fill on the destination chain, each counted once on the chain it leaves
why_compare: Fills cross-chain orders from takers' own funds on the destination chain
